sourceChanges.reason: Original framebuffer mapped pixel bits instead of bytes, extending eight times beyond mode memory. Original print_date wrote four year digits into char date[2], corrupting its stack; use four-byte digit storage. Original sprite loads requested RGB565 numeric2 while this renderer consumes three packed RGB bytes per pixel; request named XPM_8_8_8 matching the original1152x864x24 mode. Actual map boundary, stack-protected four-digit date rendering, and actual startup six-sprite format fixtures observed RED then GREEN. Final original game art, movement, shots, enemy wave, charge, pause/resume verified by browser touch.

Original startup requested RGB565 numeric2 for six sprites consumed by the packed24 renderer. Use named XPM_8_8_8 matching original VBE0x14b. Actual proj_main_loop fixture checks mode and all six resulting sprite formats, RED565 then GREEN888.
